8	/-!
9	# Obligation I-0492 4(i) DISCHARGED from the seed, at an arbitrary widened cover
10	
11	Protection I-0492 clause 4(i) relocates — rather than removes — the *fibrewise-finite support*
12	obligation, and requires it to come from the seed's own degree data rather than hide inside a
13	`LocalEquations`.  `DivisorFamilyAffMapAlg.lean` restated it on the fibre curve
14	(`AffAdaptation.eqn_tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff`) but explicitly left it an obligation.
15	This file discharges it.
16	
17	## Why this is possible at all, and it is a statement about the *shape* of the seed input
18	
19	The chart-typed lane discharges its own `hfib` through
20	`DivisorAdaptation.eqn_tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_seed`, and the temptation is to read that
21	as chart-typed machinery.  It is not.  Trace its input: it consumes
22	`ThetaGeneratorSeed.germ_self_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors`, whose statement mentions
23	
24	* the local-equation system `d = D.localEquations hD`,
25	* the fibre curve over `κ(p)`,
26	* and NOTHING ELSE — no cover, no pieces, no chart, no partition of unity.
27	
28	It says: *the pulled system equation is regular at its own point on every residue-field fibre*.
29	That is a property of the seed and the fibre, so it is available verbatim to a widened cover.
30	What the chart-typed layer adds on top of it is only the comparison "the pulled PIECE equation
31	is a unit multiple of the pulled SYSTEM equation", and `eqn_rel` — a field of `AffAdaptation`
32	too — is the whole content of that comparison.
33	
34	So obligation 4(i) is not a chart-typed accident: it transports, and it transports at an
35	ARBITRARY affine open, because the piece enters only through `eqn_rel` and the affine germ seam.
36	
37	## Main declarations
38	
39	* `AlgebraicGeometry.AffAdaptation.exists_germ_pulledEqn_eq_unit_mul_pullbackEqn` — the reverse
40	  orientation of the comparison in `germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors`, at the point itself
41	  and with **no projectivity hypothesis** (that hypothesis is what the forward direction needs
42	  and this one does not).
43	* `AlgebraicGeometry.AffAdaptation.pulledEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_self_pullbackEqn` — from
44	  self-regularity of the pulled system, section-level regularity of every pulled piece equation.
45	* `AlgebraicGeometry.AffAdaptation.eqn_tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_self_pullbackEqn` — the
46	  same read in the tensor shape the certificate assembler asks for.
47	* `AlgebraicGeometry.ThetaGeneratorSeed.affAdaptation_fibre_regular` — **obligation 4(i),
48	  discharged**: for a theta-generator seed, EVERY widened adaptation over EVERY widened cover
49	  satisfies the assembler's `hfib`, uniformly in the cover, the piece and the prime.
50	-/

8	/-!
9	# Germ-regularity engines for pulled local equations (DD-2 stage S5b kit)
10	
11	Generic engines for the regularity side-condition of `LocalEquations.pullback`
12	(`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2 — the S5b `IsLocallyCertified` layer): germ
13	regularity of pulled equations is member-normalizable, `DivEq`-invariant, compatible
14	with composition of comparisons, and **Zariski-local on the source** for covers by
15	open immersions.
16	
17	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_forall_self`
18	  — member normalization: regularity of each pulled equation at the base point of its
19	  own member suffices (the transition units of the base system pull back through
20	  `pullback_ratio_eq`).
21	* `…germ_self_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_divEq` and the full form
22	  `…germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_divEq` — germ regularity of pulled
23	  equations transports across `DivEq` (the pointwise units pull back through
24	  `unitsAppLE`).
25	* `…germ_pullbackEqn_comp` — the pulled-equation germ of a composite comparison is the
26	  germ of the two-stage pullback (`Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE` at the germ level).
27	* `…germ_pullbackEqn_congr` — the pulled-equation germ at propositionally equal
28	  comparisons.
29	* `…germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_immersion_cover` — **Zariski locality**:
30	  pulled-equation germ regularity along `f : Y ⟶ X` may be checked after composing
31	  with any jointly surjective family of open immersions into `Y` (their stalk
32	  comparisons are isomorphisms).
33	
34	Consumed by `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZar` (the `IsLocallyCertified`
35	carrier and its mapAlg-hreg engine) and the S5b gluing files.
36	-/

40	spellings downstream; the S2 file's pinned defeq discipline is kept for coherence. -/
41	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
42	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
43	depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/

56	/-- A ring isomorphism carries nonzerodivisors to nonzerodivisors. -/
57	private lemma equiv_map_mem_nonZeroDivisors {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
58	    (e : A ≃+* B) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ nonZeroDivisors A) : e a ∈ nonZeroDivisors B := by
59	  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff] at ha ⊢
60	  obtain ⟨hl, hr⟩ := ha
61	  constructor
62	  · intro b hb
63	    have h := congrArg e.symm hb
64	    rw [map_mul, map_zero, e.symm_apply_apply] at h
